## Chapter 5B Routing Decision

**Ruler:** Andrés Manuel López Obrador (Mexico)
**Period implied by source coverage:** Pre-presidency through 2018 election victory (final section ends before policy execution)
**Source:** BOOK-013 — CIDOB political biography

---

### Included Chunks — 5B Lens Citations

| chunk_id | Decision | Applicable Lenses | Adjacent Context |
|---|---|---|---|
| **U0005** | **INCLUDE** | 5B.1, 5B.6, 5B.9, 5B.10 | Campaign platform specifics: "austeridad republicana" reorienting current spending to investment without tax increases; attention to "causas sociales" and poverty; energy self-sufficiency; "pacify" in three years; defense of migrants; anti-corruption pledges. First explicit policy program with direct economic content. |
| **U0006** | **INCLUDE** | 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.4, 5B.8 | Describes "socialdemocracia pragmática" platform: assumes orthodox free-market principles (macro stability, budget discipline, peso flotation) alongside rejection of "privatizadoras" and "extranjerización"; priority to national production; explicit on distribution ("prioridad para los más humildes"). Contains both structural policy orientation and stated distributive intent. |
| **U0062** | **INCLUDE** | 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.6, 5B.8, 5B.9 | Full explicit program details: austerity-without-tax-increases fiscal rule; gradual minimum-wage increase; pension expansion for seniors; gasoline self-sufficiency via refineries; energy-reform reversal; 6% annual growth target; 1.2M jobs/year; food self-sufficiency; public university and health coverage; response to Trump tariffs and NAFTA renegotiation. Most comprehensive single-chunk economic program statement. |
| **U0063** | **INCLUDE** | 5B.1, 5B.2, 5B.6, 5B.7, 5B.9 | "Pacificar" strategy addressing root social causes of violence; anti-corruption "dando ejemplo" from Los Pinos; economic competence signaling (explicitly invokes macroeconomic orthodoxy); shock-management posture toward Trump trade pressure and tariff threats; conditional amnesty for narcotics; gradual military withdrawal. Contains both policy program and crisis-management orientation. |

---

### Excluded Chunks — Auditable Justification

| chunk_id | Exclusion Reason |
|---|---|
| **U0001** | Basic identity and bibliographic header — no policy content. |
| **U0002** | Electoral history 2000–2018 framing; political mobilization and opposition positioning; no specific economic policy content. |
| **U0003** | 2006 electoral fraud claim, "presidencia legítima" declaration; political legitimacy dispute, not economic policy. |
| **U0004** | Opposition to Peña Nieto's structural reforms (energy, telecom, education, labor); general anti-corruption rhetoric; no direct economic-wellbeing program content. |
| **U0007** | Migration caravans, border tensions with Trump, visa policy; trade and diplomatic context but no domestic economic policy. |
| **U0008–U0017** | Pre-2000 biographical material: PRI functionary career, PRD founding, 1991 democracy march, 1994 gubernatorial campaign, party presidency, FOBAPROA opposition; background context only. |
| **U0018–U0020** | 2000 DF electoral victory, early DF government character assessments; no specific economic program evidence. |
| **U0021** | DF government social programs (Pensión Universal Alimenticia); partial social-welfare content but no 5B-specific economic management evidence — program described by opposition as populist budget-wasting. |
| **U0022–U0027** | Video scandal (2004), desafuero proceedings (2004–2005); political-legal crisis management, not economic policy. |
| **U0028–U0039** | 2006 presidential campaign and "presidencia legítima" parallel government; electoral fraud claims, opposition mobilization; no enacted economic policy. |
| **U0040–U0043** | Internal PRD factional conflicts (Los Chuchos vs. lopezobradoristas), 2008–2010 party institutional disputes; economic rhetoric only as electoral context. |
| **U0044–U0051** | 2012 presidential campaign, electoral fraud claims, TEPJF defeat; MORENA founding; no specific 5B economic program content. |
| **U0052–U0054** | Break from PRD, MORENA institutionalization, opposition to EPN structural reforms; general anti-corruption and sovereignty rhetoric. |
| **U0055** | 2015 electoral results for MORENA; no economic policy content. |
| **U0056–U0061** | Electoral trajectory 2015–2018, polling position, campaign launch; coalition formation (Juntos Haremos Historia); pre-program context only. |
| **U0064–U0066** | July 2018 electoral victory; victory speech; congressional majority results; future program implications only. |
| **U0067** | CIDOB institutional footer; no ruler content. |

---

### Routing Summary

- **Total chunks evaluated:** 67 (U0001–U0067)
- **Included for 5B:** 4 chunks — U0005, U0006, U0062, U0063
- **Excluded:** 63 chunks
- **Key gap:** Source terminates at mid-2018 inauguration. No executed-budget evidence, no implementation evidence, no outcome indicators, and no post-inauguration economic governance data are present. 5B.10 (trajectory comparison) cannot be answered from this source; chunks that speak to promised trajectory are included for the program evidence they contain but do not constitute outcome evidence.
